### RLI Third Quarter Earnings Release & Teleconference


October 1, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s204.q4cdn.com/949661285/files/doc_news/RLI-Third-Quarter-Earnings-Release--Teleconference-2026.pdf)


PEORIA, Ill.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


RLI Corp. (NYSE: RLI) announced today that it will release its third quarter 2026 earnings after market close on Monday, October 19, 2026.


The company will hold its quarterly conference call to discuss third quarter results on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. CDT. This call is being webcast by Q4 and can be accessed at[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/320165068](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F320165068&esheet=54612163&newsitemid=20261001534830&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F320165068&index=1&md5=d4bfaa785ac3b04346b5fa6773d84f18) .


**ABOUT RLI**


RLI Corp. (NYSE: RLI) is a specialty insurer serving niche property, casualty and surety markets. The company provides deep underwriting expertise and superior service to commercial and personal lines customers nationwide. RLI’s products are offered through its insurance subsidiaries RLI Insurance Company, Mt. Hawley Insurance Company and Contractors Bonding and Insurance Company. All of RLI’s subsidiaries are rated A++ “Superior” by AM Best Company. RLI has paid and increased regular dividends for 51 consecutive years and delivered underwriting profits for 30 consecutive years. To learn more about RLI, visit[www.rlicorp.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.rlicorp.com&esheet=54612163&newsitemid=20261001534830&lan=en-US&anchor=www.rlicorp.com&index=2&md5=dea409748e57ce837591c97badcfc2c3) .
